constelacion.reason: Its grammar is a central subject related to several real semantic nodes; one Hero plus text cannot materialize those nodes honestly.

marcoPoster.reason: A single Hero and a bounded text region fully materialize the poster grammar.

editorial.reason: Text is the first-class subject and no asset slot is required.

capasApiladas.reason: Layering is only meaningful when two or more real layers or concepts exist.

redNodos.reason: A network needs multiple materialized nodes; generic dots would be false structure.

lineaTiempo.reason: A timeline requires multiple ordered events, which SceneSpec V14 does not carry.

corteTransversal.reason: The cross-section grammar requires multiple named strata.

partidoVertical.reason: One Hero and one text block can occupy opposite fields without placeholders.

cintaDiagonal.reason: The diagonal axis can relate one Hero to one text region.

anillosConcentricos.reason: The rings express focus around one real Hero without inventing Support.

abanicoTarjetas.reason: A fan of cards requires several materialized cards or assets.

rayosImpacto.reason: Impact geometry can subordinate itself to one Hero or to editorial text as subject.

engranajes.reason: Interlocking gears encode multiple interacting parts.

cuaderno.reason: A document field can contain one Hero and an adjacent annotation, or text alone.

cascada.reason: A cascade requires an ordered series of distinct real items.

mundoIsometrico.reason: The world is built from several tiles or objects, not one repeated placeholder.

pilaVertical.reason: A stack requires multiple real blocks or concepts.
